faqs.question: How is this different from regular Minoxidil?
faqs.answer: Three major differences: (1) Our formula adds topical Finasteride to block DHT — Minoxidil alone only stimulates growth without addressing the root cause. (2) CETOSOMAL® technology delivers 2–3x better penetration than standard aqueous formulas. (3) Our formula is alcohol-free, preventing the scalp dryness common with other products, especially important in Indian conditions.

faqs.question: Will this affect my sexual performance?
faqs.answer: Our topical Finasteride formulation is specifically designed for localized delivery, resulting in significantly lower systemic absorption compared to oral Finasteride pills. Studies show topical application achieves comparable DHT reduction at the scalp with a fraction of the systemic exposure. That said, if you have concerns, consult with your doctor through our free consultation service.

faqs.question: Why is there initial shedding? Should I be worried?
faqs.answer: Initial shedding (usually in weeks 2–6) is actually a positive sign that the treatment is working. Here's why: Minoxidil pushes follicles from the resting phase into the growth phase. The old, weak, miniaturized hairs fall out to make room for new, stronger hair growth. This is temporary and subsides within 4–8 weeks. Don't stop treatment during this phase, that's when it matters most.

faqs.question: How long before I see results?
faqs.answer: Hair growth takes time, expect 5–6 months of consistent use to see visible results. Month 1–2: Shedding phase Month 3–4: Stabilization and early regrowth Month 5–6: Visible improvement 92.7% of users see results by month 5–6. The Advanced Protocol may show results 4–6 weeks faster than our Essential formula.

faqs.question: What if I stop using the product?
faqs.answer: Hair regrowth from Minoxidil and Finasteride is maintenance-dependent. If you stop treatment, the benefits will gradually reverse over 6–12 months as DHT resumes its attack on follicles and blood flow returns to baseline. Think of it like exercise, you need to keep doing it to keep the results. If you wish to stop usage, taper it slowly and only after consultation with a doctor.

faqs.question: Is this safe for long-term use?
faqs.answer: Yes. Topical Minoxidil has been used safely for over 40 years and is FDA-approved for hair regrowth. Topical Finasteride has a strong safety profile when used as directed. Our Biotin Gummies are made with 100% vegan, sugar-free ingredients safe for daily use. All formulations are dermatologist-approved and made in India under strict quality standards.

faqs.question: Will this grow hair on other parts of my body?
faqs.answer: With topical application, hair growth is localized to where you apply it. Some users report mild facial hair growth if solution runs down from the scalp - wipe the area after application to avoid run-off.
